 UP Government Holiday List 2027 Released: Check Public and Restricted Holidays in Uttar Pradesh
 By Pratyasha Chaturvedi Last Updated: Nov 18, 2026, 09:36 IST UP Government Holiday List 2027 has been released. Check the complete list of public and restricted holidays in Uttar Pradesh, including Holi, Diwali, Eid and other festivals. Check the complete list below.
 UP Government Holiday List 2027 Released Key Points
 The UP Government released its 2027 holiday list on November 17, 2026.
 The 2027 list includes 26 public holidays and 27 restricted holidays.
 Banks, treasuries, and sub-treasuries will be closed on April 1, 2027.
 The Uttar Pradesh government has released the UP Government Holiday List 2027 for the government offices across the state. The holiday calendar was issued on November 17, 2027, 2026 , by the General Administration Department. This holiday list includes public holidays, restricted holidays and additional holidays for the upcoming year, that is 2027. As per the official notification, the state government has declared around 26 public holiday under the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1818. Additionally, 27 restricted holidays have also been announced for 2027. An extra public holiday will also be observed on October 15 on the occasion of Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti.  
 Government employees and residents can check the complete UP Holiday Calendar 2027 to plan their leaves, travel and other activities in advance.

 UP Restricted Holidays 2027 Important Dates 
 Apart from the public holidays, the Uttar Pradesh government has announced 27 restricted holidays. These holidays allow eligible employees to choose holidays according to the applicable government rules. Some of the important restricted holidays include the following days:- 
 January 1, 2027 for New Year 
 February 11, 2027 for Basant Panchami 
 March 5, 2027 for Jamat-ul-vida 
 March 24, 2027 for Holi 
 April 7, 2027 for Cheti Chand 
 May 8, 2027 for Parshuram Jayanti 
 July 25, 2027 for Hartalika Teej 
 September 14, 2027 for Anant Chaturdashi 
 September 17, 2027 for Vishwakarma Puja 
 October 28, 2027 Narak Chaturdashi 
 November 4, 2027 for Chhath Puja 
 November 16, 2027 for Veeranga Uda Devi Martyrdom Day 
 December 23, 2027 for Chaudhary Charan Singh Jayanti 
 December 24, 2027 for Christmas Eve

 Important Instructions for the Government Employees of Uttar Pradesh 
 The government has also issued some additional instructions along with the UP Government Holiday Calendar 2027. These instructions are as follows:- 
 District Magistrates can declare up to three local holidays in their respective districts. 
 Banks will remain closed on April 1, 2027, due to annual account closing. This holiday applies to banks, treasuroies and sub-treasuries. 
 If two festivals or important occasions fall on the same date, no additional compensatory public holiday wull be declared.  
 Dates of festivals dependent on the sighting of the moon may change according to local observations.  
 Employees are advised to check the official notification for complete details about public and restricted holidays before planning their leave.
